totals.note: Forward totals include startup, graph/capture warmup, initialization, warm requests, qualification repeats and all completed study requests. The FULL parent exited without wait-status; its allocation has a measured worker duration and a 15-second-polled launch-to-exit upper bound. Physical denoising attention denominators exclude dense prefill/commit; those ordinary forwards are counted separately. Audit/operator nested times are not added to request time.
